great_drowning_flood_marks.name: Great Drowning
great_drowning_flood_marks.observation: The sea broke the dunes in one night and drowned whole parishes; the survivors cut the height of the water on the walls of the god's houses.
great_drowning_flood_marks.social_consequence: The drowned parishes are never resettled, and their dues pass to the villages that survived.

post_plague_woodland.name: Post-Plague Woodland
post_plague_woodland.observation: Woods creep back over ploughland left empty by the great dying, and the lords fence the new growth as their own.

pine_seed_row_sowing.name: Row-Sown Pine
pine_seed_row_sowing.observation: Foresters sow pine seed in rows on the cleared ground, and a young wood stands where the burners left bare earth.

salmon_conservators.name: Salmon Conservators
salmon_conservators.observation: Conservators and their bailiffs watch the rivers in the spawning season and seize nets set across the runs.

leased_fuel_blocks.name: Leased Fuel Blocks
leased_fuel_blocks.observation: The town leases its woods to charcoal and glass burners by measured block, and each must stay inside his marks.

yearly_felling_blocks.name: Yearly Felling Blocks
yearly_felling_blocks.observation: The wood is cut in yearly blocks in strict rotation, and each block has grown back before the axes return.

herring_shoal_shift.name: Herring Shift
herring_shoal_shift.observation: The herring no longer come to the old grounds, and the boats sail two days farther to find them.
herring_shoal_shift.social_consequence: The fishing towns that lived on the herring shrink, and their young people leave for the new grounds.

sheep_enclosure_depopulation.name: Sheep Enclosures
sheep_enclosure_depopulation.observation: Hedges go up around the ploughland, the tenants are turned out, and one shepherd and his dog keep a township's fields.
sheep_enclosure_depopulation.social_consequence: Evicted tenants crowd the roads and towns while the landlords' flocks graze the old ploughland.

cold_margin_abandonment.name: Cold Margin Retreat
cold_margin_abandonment.observation: In the cold decades the upland and ice-front farms fail harvest after harvest and are left to heath and snow.
cold_margin_abandonment.social_consequence: Upland families come down into crowded valleys, and the old hill farms become names in the tax rolls.

replant_on_cut_licence.name: Replant-on-Cut Licence
replant_on_cut_licence.observation: A charcoal burner's licence binds him to replant what he cuts, and the forester checks the young trees the next spring.

arsenal_oak_reserves.name: Arsenal Oak Reserves
arsenal_oak_reserves.observation: Every oak in the state reserves is counted and marked with the arsenal's sign, and none may be cut without its order.
arsenal_oak_reserves.ability_reason: The arsenal can count on seasoned oak a generation ahead, so a lost fleet can be rebuilt.
arsenal_oak_reserves.social_consequence: Villagers lose the right to cut or graze in the marked woods, and the arsenal's foresters are hated.

smelter_fume_blight.name: Smelter Fume Blight
smelter_fume_blight.observation: Roasting fumes drift over the hills around the smelters, and the trees die from the top down.
smelter_fume_blight.social_consequence: Herders move their flocks away from the smelter hills, and the bare slopes wash into the streams.

nitre_earth_exhaustion.name: Nitre Earth Exhaustion
nitre_earth_exhaustion.observation: The stable and cellar floors have been dug too often; the nitre men must lay new beds and wait years for them to ripen.

game_damage_compensation.name: Game Damage Payments
game_damage_compensation.observation: The lord's deer and boar still eat the peasants' crops, but now the damage is assessed and paid.
game_damage_compensation.social_consequence: The peasants are paid for what the deer eat, but they still may not kill them.

illegal_weir_removal.name: Weir Removal
illegal_weir_removal.observation: Weirs built across the river without a gap for the fish are ordered pulled down, and the salmon run upstream again.

tillage_protection_laws.name: Tillage Protection
tillage_protection_laws.observation: The law forbids turning ploughland to pasture, and landlords who have done so must rebuild the farmhouses.
tillage_protection_laws.ability_reason: Ploughland can no longer be emptied for sheep, so the realm keeps the farmers who grow its bread.

wolf_extirpation.name: Wolf Extirpation
wolf_extirpation.observation: Bounties and drives have killed the last wolves of the lowlands, and only a few packs remain in the mountains.
wolf_extirpation.social_consequence: Shepherds sleep easier, but the deer multiply in the woods without the wolves.

mine_tailings_silting.name: Tailings Silting
mine_tailings_silting.observation: Crushed waste from the silver mines washes down into the river, and the meadows below are buried in grey silt after every flood.

home_fur_exhaustion.name: Home Fur Exhaustion
home_fur_exhaustion.observation: No beaver or otter is left on the home rivers, and the furriers buy their pelts from traders on the frontier.

enclosure_by_agreement.name: Enclosure by Agreement
enclosure_by_agreement.observation: The open fields and common are divided by agreement into hedged farms, each man's land in one piece.
enclosure_by_agreement.ability_reason: An improving farmer can drain, manure and rotate his own hedged fields as he chooses, and the grain surplus grows.
enclosure_by_agreement.social_consequence: Cottagers lose the common where their cow and geese grazed.

contact_species_exchange.name: Species Exchange
contact_species_exchange.observation: Seeds, weeds, pests and runaway livestock cross the ocean both ways, and neither shore looks as it did before contact.
contact_species_exchange.ability_reason: New crops and beasts from across the ocean can feed the realm, but strange weeds and pests arrive with them.
contact_species_exchange.social_consequence: Farmers try new plants from across the ocean, while new pests and diseases ruin some of the old crops.

dune_grass_laws.name: Dune Grass Laws
dune_grass_laws.observation: The coarse grass that binds the dunes is protected, and no beast may graze on them.

pressed_plant_herbaria.name: Herbaria
pressed_plant_herbaria.observation: Plants are pressed flat, dried and glued into books with their names and the place they were gathered.

comparative_anatomy.observation: The bones of birds, beasts and people are laid side by side and compared bone for bone.

mercury_amalgam_poisoning.name: Mercury Poisoning
mercury_amalgam_poisoning.observation: Silver ore trodden with quicksilver gives up its metal, and the quicksilver soaks into the miners and the streams.
mercury_amalgam_poisoning.social_consequence: Trembling hands and loose teeth mark the men who work the amalgamation yards.

statute_vermin_bounties.name: Vermin Bounties
statute_vermin_bounties.observation: Every parish pays a bounty on crows, kites, foxes and hedgehogs, and churchwardens count the heads.

goat_woodland_bans.name: Goat Bans
goat_woodland_bans.observation: Goats are barred from young woods, and a goat found browsing there is forfeit.

island_forest_felling.name: Island Forest Felling
island_forest_felling.observation: The great forests of far islands are cut for ship timber and to fuel the sugar boilers.
island_forest_felling.social_consequence: On the far islands the streams dry up and the soil washes away within a lifetime.

commercial_peat_cutting.name: Commercial Peat
commercial_peat_cutting.observation: Companies drain the raised bogs and cut peat by the boatload for the towns.

frozen_river_winters.name: Frozen River Winters
frozen_river_winters.observation: The great river freezes so hard that a fair is held on the ice, while the mills stand still and the poor go cold.

far_land_specimen_voyages.name: Specimen Voyages
far_land_specimen_voyages.observation: Naturalists sail with the ships and bring back seeds, skins and dried plants from far lands.

smelter_damage_payments.name: Smelter Damages
smelter_damage_payments.observation: The smelter owners must pay for the woods and pastures their fumes have killed, and some raise their chimneys.

private_nuisance_law.name: Nuisance Law
private_nuisance_law.observation: A court orders a neighbour's smoke, stench or foul water stopped, and the tanners and boilers must move or mend.
private_nuisance_law.ability_reason: A householder can go to court and have a neighbour's smoke, stench or foul water stopped, so the worst trades move to the edge of town.

whale_ground_depletion.name: Northern Whale Depletion
whale_ground_depletion.observation: The whales of the northern ice are gone, and the fleets sail farther each year for fewer catches.

floated_water_meadows.name: Water Meadows
floated_water_meadows.observation: Hatches let a thin sheet of river water over the meadow in winter, and the grass is green weeks before the spring.
floated_water_meadows.ability_reason: An early bite of grass lets farmers keep more sheep through the hungry spring, and so they have more dung for the fields.

last_wild_cattle.name: Last Wild Cattle
last_wild_cattle.observation: The last of the wild cattle die in a keeper's park, and no one will see them again.
last_wild_cattle.social_consequence: People now know the wild cattle of the old songs only from the horns hanging in the halls.

fur_frontier_depletion.name: Fur Frontier Depletion
fur_frontier_depletion.observation: The fur traders take every beaver from one river and move on to the next.

plantation_soil_exhaustion.name: Plantation Exhaustion
plantation_soil_exhaustion.observation: Tobacco and cane wear out the soil in a few years, and the planters burn new ground and move on.
plantation_soil_exhaustion.social_consequence: Planters move on to new ground and leave worn-out fields behind them.

glacier_farm_remission.name: Glacier Remission
glacier_farm_remission.observation: The glacier has buried a farm in the valley head, and the crown remits the tax on land under ice.

timber_import_dependence.name: Timber Imports
timber_import_dependence.observation: Home oak runs short, so building timber and masts come by sea from the far northern forests.
timber_import_dependence.social_consequence: The shipyards depend on a foreign timber trade, and a war in the north can stop them.

instrumental_weather_registers.name: Weather Registers
instrumental_weather_registers.observation: Thermometer and barometer are read at fixed hours and written in a register kept for years.

oak_planting_treatise.name: Oak Planting
oak_planting_treatise.observation: A printed treatise urges every landowner to plant oak for the fleet, and many do so on poor ground.

coal_smoke_treatise.name: Coal Smoke Treatise
coal_smoke_treatise.observation: A treatise on the capital's coal smoke proposes moving the brewers, lime burners and dyers out and planting gardens against the smoke.
coal_smoke_treatise.ability_reason: The ruler now has a reasoned case for moving the smoky trades out of the capital.

fossil_organic_origin.name: Fossils as Remains
fossil_organic_origin.observation: The shells and bones found in rock are shown to be the remains of once-living creatures, not tricks of the stone.

island_extinction_record.name: Island Extinction
island_extinction_record.observation: A large flightless bird was killed and eaten by every passing crew, and within a lifetime none are left.

realm_forest_ordinance.name: Realm Forest Ordinance
realm_forest_ordinance.observation: One forest ordinance governs every wood in the realm, and a forest master in each district decides what may be cut.
realm_forest_ordinance.ability_reason: Forest masters can say how much timber the realm has and where, so arsenals, mines and towns are supplied without stripping the woods.
realm_forest_ordinance.social_consequence: Peasants lose their rights to litter, pannage and firewood under the forest masters' rules.

oyster_spat_relaying.name: Oyster Relaying
oyster_spat_relaying.observation: Young oysters are dredged from healthy beds and laid on the worn-out ones, and the beds are closed until they grow.

relative_stratigraphy.observation: Layers of rock are read in order down the cliff, and the lower layer is always the older.
relative_stratigraphy.ability_reason: Surveyors can follow a coal or clay bed from one valley to the next by the layers above and below it.

property_game_qualification.name: Game Qualification
property_game_qualification.observation: Only a man who holds land of a set value may hunt, and the rest may not keep a gun or a dog for it.
property_game_qualification.social_consequence: Poaching becomes a crime of the poor, and keepers and poachers fight in the woods at night.

covered_field_drains.name: Covered Drains
covered_field_drains.observation: Trenches packed with brush and stones are covered over, and wet clay fields dry out in time for spring sowing.

habitat_observation_records.observation: A county's plants, beasts and soils are described from dated field notes, parish by parish.

peat_shrinkage_pumping.name: Peat Shrinkage
peat_shrinkage_pumping.observation: The drained fen peat dries and shrinks below the rivers, and every decade more mills are needed to keep it dry.
peat_shrinkage_pumping.social_consequence: Each generation of fen farmers must pay for more mills to keep the fields their parents won.

trade_wind_map.name: Trade Wind Map
trade_wind_map.observation: A world map shows the trade winds and the monsoons with arrows, drawn from many voyages.

tall_chimney_orders.name: Tall Chimney Orders
tall_chimney_orders.observation: Brewers and dyers must carry their smoke up tall chimneys above the neighbouring roofs.

pannage_decline.name: End of Pannage
pannage_decline.observation: The woods are enclosed, the swine are penned and fed on scraps, and the autumn acorn feeding ends.

storm_path_reconstruction.name: Storm Path Reconstruction
storm_path_reconstruction.observation: Letters from every county are gathered after the great storm, and its path and hour are pieced together across the realm.

game_bird_close_seasons.name: Close Seasons
game_bird_close_seasons.observation: No partridge or grouse may be shot while they nest and rear their young.

sustained_yield_forestry.name: Sustained Yield
sustained_yield_forestry.observation: The forester measures the growth of each wood and cuts no more in a year than grows back.
sustained_yield_forestry.ability_reason: Fuel, ship timber and building timber can last for ever instead of running out, because each wood is cut only as fast as it regrows.

cattle_plague_slaughter_orders.name: Cattle Plague Orders
cattle_plague_slaughter_orders.observation: When the cattle plague comes, sick herds are slaughtered and burned, no beast may be moved, and owners are paid for their losses.
cattle_plague_slaughter_orders.social_consequence: Farmers watch their herds burned, and some hide sick beasts rather than lose them.

cattle_health_passes.name: Cattle Health Passes
cattle_health_passes.observation: Drovers must carry a certificate that their cattle come from a clean parish.

hedgerow_timber_planting.name: Hedgerow Timber
hedgerow_timber_planting.observation: Oak and ash saplings are planted in the new enclosure hedges to grow into timber trees.

brown_rat_invasion.name: Brown Rat Invasion
brown_rat_invasion.observation: Bigger brown rats come ashore in the ports, drive out the black rat and spread into every barn and granary.

plant_transpiration_measurement.observation: A potted plant is weighed morning and evening, and the water it draws up and breathes out is measured.

caterpillar_nest_ordinance.name: Caterpillar Ordinance
caterpillar_nest_ordinance.observation: Every householder must cut the caterpillar nests from his hedges and trees in winter and burn them.

biological_classification.observation: Every plant and animal gets a two-part name and a place in a nested scheme of kinds.
biological_classification.ability_reason: Naturalists everywhere can name the same plant or beast in the same way, so reports of crops, pests and useful species can be compared.

tree_ring_notes.name: Tree Ring Notes
tree_ring_notes.observation: Rings on the stumps are counted back to date the wet and dry years.

pheasant_preserves.name: Pheasant Preserves
pheasant_preserves.observation: Keepers rear pheasants by the hundred for the guns and kill every hawk, owl and polecat on the estate.

dye_works_nuisance.name: Dye Works Nuisance
dye_works_nuisance.observation: The waste of the dye and bleach works is ruled a nuisance, and they must settle it in pits before it reaches the river.

tree_volume_tables.name: Tree Volume Tables
tree_volume_tables.observation: Tables give the timber in a standing tree from its girth and height, so a wood can be valued before felling.

economy_of_nature.name: Economy of Nature
economy_of_nature.observation: Each creature is seen to have its place in a balance of eating and being eaten.
economy_of_nature.ability_reason: Improvers can see that killing a hawk or draining a marsh changes what else lives there, so rules on woods, game and fisheries can look further ahead.

biological_reference_collections.observation: Named and numbered type specimens stand in a public cabinet, where anyone can compare a find against them.

phenology_records.name: Phenology Records
phenology_records.observation: The day of the first flowers and the first swallows is written down every year.

dune_pine_plantations.name: Dune Pine Plantations
dune_pine_plantations.observation: Marram grass and then pine are planted on the moving dunes, and the sand stops burying the farms behind them.

firebreak_rides.name: Firebreak Rides
firebreak_rides.observation: Wide rides cut through the pine plantations stop a fire from sweeping the whole forest.

assembly_enclosure_acts.name: Enclosure Acts
assembly_enclosure_acts.observation: Commissioners survey a parish's commons and open fields under an act of the assembly and reallot them as fenced farms.
assembly_enclosure_acts.ability_reason: A whole parish can be reallotted into fenced farms in a few seasons, so improved husbandry spreads across the realm quickly.
assembly_enclosure_acts.social_consequence: Commoners lose their grazing, fuel and gleaning rights; many become wage labourers or leave for the towns.

veterinary_schools.name: Veterinary Schools
veterinary_schools.observation: A school trains horse and cattle doctors in anatomy and the diseases of stock.

desiccation_forest_reserves.name: Rain Forest Reserves
desiccation_forest_reserves.observation: The hill forests of a far island are reserved because the settlers believe that cutting them brings drought.
desiccation_forest_reserves.ability_reason: Governors of far islands can reserve the hill forests to keep the rains and springs, so colonies need not strip themselves bare.

state_nitre_plantations.name: State Nitre Plantations
state_nitre_plantations.observation: Nitre beds are laid out in rows under state inspectors, who test and buy the crop each year.

colonial_plant_transfers.name: Colonial Plant Transfers
colonial_plant_transfers.observation: State gardens carry useful plants from one far colony to another, and new crops take root on strange shores.

charcoal_wood_clearance.name: Charcoal Wood Clearance
charcoal_wood_clearance.observation: Coal fires the furnaces now, so the old coppices are grubbed up and turned into farms.

weather_observer_network.name: Weather Observer Network
weather_observer_network.observation: Observers in many realms read matched instruments at the same hours and send their tables to one society.
weather_observer_network.ability_reason: Observers can compare the same storm or frost from place to place, the first step toward foreseeing bad seasons.

mineral_cleavage.observation: Minerals are sorted by the way they split along smooth faces or break unevenly.

volcanic_dry_fog_year.name: Dry Fog Year
volcanic_dry_fog_year.observation: A dry fog from a distant eruption hangs over the summer, the crops wither and the parish registers fill with burials.
volcanic_dry_fog_year.social_consequence: A summer of fog, a failed harvest, and burials counted parish by parish.

deep_time_geology.name: Deep Time
deep_time_geology.observation: The slow laying-down of rock beds shows the earth to be far older than any chronicle.
deep_time_geology.ability_reason: Surveyors reckon the earth in ages rather than generations, so they can read how rock beds, soils and coal were laid down and where to look for more.

ocean_whaling_depletion.name: Ocean Whaling
ocean_whaling_depletion.observation: Whalers boil down the blubber in brick try-works on deck and stay out for years on every ocean.

torrent_check_dams.name: Torrent Check Dams
torrent_check_dams.observation: Small dams of stone and wattle across the torrent beds and new trees on the slopes hold back the floods.

town_river_fish_kills.name: Town River Fouling
town_river_fish_kills.observation: Fish float dead below the growing towns, and the fouling of the river is recorded year by year.

extinction_recognized.name: Extinction Recognized
extinction_recognized.observation: The bones of great beasts are shown to belong to kinds that live nowhere on earth now.

condensing_smelter_flues.name: Condensing Flues
condensing_smelter_flues.observation: Long flues running up the hillside cool the smelter fumes, and lead is scraped from their walls instead of falling on the pastures.
